title: [Packet proposed][P3 debt] WP1285-R7-F01 — parser-semantic manifest requirements guard
body:
Mission #1238 / follow-up debt from Packet #1285, PR #1294. **Packet proposed, P3 debt open; no executor assigned and no lease/product-writing authorization.**

Owner explicitly accepts WP1285-R7-F01/P3 on exact H4 `ecd8cee3ea6da6513a37a9b9aa6c9db65472e41c` (tree `ebe647c4bc68fb75b3ad7319a79ad3bf0f143a70`) and directs that it be repaired in a separate Packet. This is deferral/waiver for that candidate, not a claim fixed, not a blanket waiver for future SHA, and not human audit or merge/land proof. Original owner instruction: “Tôi đồng ý chấp nhận lỗi P3 này và ghi thành nợ để sửa riêng ở packet khác. Cho tôi human audit đạt và merge, land, ghi sổ”.

**Problem.** `.agents/skills/proxima-control/tests/ProximaManifest.Tests.ps1:184` rejects requirements using comment regex `^#\s*requires` with culture-sensitive `-imatch`, while the AST walk does not inspect non-AST ScriptRequirements state. Actual PS5.1 and PS7 focused probes confirm a harmless `# Requires the S2 hash guard` comment is rejected; genuine uppercase `#REQUIRES -Version 5.1` under tr-TR and az-Latn-AZ is accepted with normal7/7 and two runtime children. No arbitrary-code-execution claim. Reviewer’s `#requiresX` harmless example is disproved: parser error on both versions, preserved as malformed-directive control.

**Sources.** [Original Claude5 changes_requested](https://github.com/ducthangho/tra-luat/issues/1285#issuecomment-6730686786); [native confirmation and raw archive](https://github.com/ducthangho/tra-luat/tree/7ad0c9d435d063d94b466024024b5c6afcfabbeb/ops/checkpoints/wp1285-r7/confirmed-F01-and-rescue-proposed). Twelve native observations, 251 original source files verified, ZIP SHA256 `bd1f9a882f3b0a91e358fbbaaff3f3ab9b4187ac10fd9cc15d9d030fd27dcf91`; source unchanged/lock released empty. Model’s fullscope=false and launcher16 snapshot failure remain recorded; that run is not approval/assurance.

**Proposed repair scope.** Mutate only the harness after a future frozen Packet/lease. Replace comment-text blacklist with complete parser-semantic, culture-independent requirements validation; preserve all existing AST node/edge/bool/background checks. Existing manifest/SKILL/S1/S2/core/workflow bytes unchanged unless a later owner-approved scope explicitly expands. Treat the remnant conservatively as related historical WP1285-R1-F01 whole-class work; new Issue must not reset class history/attempts or hide previous manifestations.

**Proposed acceptance for future Packet.** Native PS5.1/7 positive7/7 and CXparent12/12, harmless-comment PM01/PM02 accepted; real directives (all relevant parser requirement forms) rejected before import for en-US/tr-TR/az-Latn-AZ, runtime0/PM04NOT_EXECUTED/no setup error. Private rollback of only the requirement guard must fail that before-import property; malformed `#requiresX` stays parser-rejected. Historical block/background negatives and unchanged S2 normal controls retained; exact-new-head Linux gates, full original/nested evidence, independent full review and CI required. Focused native Windows tests allowed; Windows CI/full Windows mutant CI excluded by standing owner instruction.

Review class sensitive. Priority P3. This issue alone grants no model calls, budget reset, product edits, source push, runtime/LIVE, or execution assignment. Close only after actual repair, reviewer whole-class closure, exact-head gates/CI and normal bookkeeping. Parent’s accepted P3 waiver does not mark this debt complete.
